item.title: September 4th Patch TLDR
item.description:
Patch Summary — September 4, 2026

Patch: Mouseover Tooltips, Transcribers and Many More QoL Updates

This is primarily a quality-of-life and creature-ability update, with several useful Tamer changes.

Biggest Changes

  • Storage Shelves: Added named Storage Shelf Loadouts with dedicated management, dropdown selection, and quick switching.
  • Tooltips: Most in-game Info buttons now show their information on mouseover instead of requiring a click.
  • Aspect Item Tomes: Can now store Chromatic Cores and Chromatic Distillations.
  • Codex Loadouts: Deleting a loadout now automatically selects the next one instead of jumping back to the first.
  • Creature DoTs: Bleed, Disease, and Poison from recently killed non-tamed creatures now continue ticking properly.
  • Provocation: Maximum range is now a fixed 40 tiles, replacing the old variable-distance Tether mechanic.
  • Crafting: Reagent-based crafting now properly contributes to Scientist achievements and Artisan Aspect XP.

Tamer / Creature Changes

A large number of creature abilities have been converted into passive abilities, meaning they now trigger automatically from attacks or spells rather than functioning as manually activated abilities.

item.title: Standard Gatherer
item.description:
Overview

A straightforward gathering template that combines resource gathering with a basic mage and summoner setup. It can be built around either Lumberjacking or Mining, allowing you to collect resources while still having the tools to deal with creatures you encounter in the field.

The combination of Magery, Meditation, and the Wizard’s Grimoire provides reliable spellcasting, while the Summoner’s Tome gives you summoned creatures to help handle PvM threats without turning the character into a dedicated combat build.

item.title: Mad Shepherd
item.description:
Overview

This is a general-purpose Tamer build designed for PvM and farming. It combines a strong tamed creature with melee damage and utility skills to provide a flexible and relatively inexpensive farming setup.

The build is intended to be easy to get started with while still providing enough room to improve as better equipment, aspects, and chain links become available.

Aspect Options

There are several viable aspect choices depending on how you want to play the build.
